ledger = [
    {"id": "REQ-1", "kind": "functional",     "status": "confirmed", "text": "search patient by last name"},
    {"id": "REQ-2", "kind": "non-functional", "status": "draft",     "text": "search result in under 1 second"},
    {"id": "REQ-3", "kind": "functional",     "status": "draft",     "text": "flag patient needs interpreter"},
    {"id": "REQ-4", "kind": "non-functional", "status": "draft",     "text": "99.5% uptime on weekdays"},
    {"id": "REQ-5", "kind": "functional",     "status": "confirmed", "text": "mark appointment as arrived"},
]

total = len(ledger)
confirmed = sum(1 for r in ledger if r["status"] == "confirmed")
quality = sum(1 for r in ledger if r["kind"] == "non-functional")

print("total:", total)
print("confirmed:", confirmed)
print("quality:", quality)
print("unmatured drafts:", sum(1 for r in ledger if r["kind"] == "non-functional" and r["status"] == "draft"))

# سجلّ متطلبات عيادة — عدّل، أضف، وراقب العدّادات.
ledger = [
    {"id": "REQ-1", "kind": "functional",     "status": "draft",     "text": "search by last name"},
    {"id": "REQ-2", "kind": "non-functional", "status": "draft",     "text": "load quickly"},
    {"id": "REQ-3", "kind": "functional",     "status": "confirmed", "text": "mark appointment arrived"},
]

def show(records):
    for r in records:
        print(r["id"], "|", r["kind"], "|", r["status"], "|", r["text"])
    print("total:", len(records))
    print("confirmed:", sum(1 for r in records if r["status"] == "confirmed"))
    print("quality:", sum(1 for r in records if r["kind"] == "non-functional"))

show(ledger)

notes = [
    {"who": "clerk",      "text": "search appointments by patient name", "tag": "need"},
    {"who": "manager",    "text": "cut check-in time to 15 seconds",     "tag": "goal"},
    {"who": "compliance", "text": "keep the audit log for 7 years",      "tag": "constraint"},
    {"who": "clerk",      "text": "flag difficult patients",             "tag": "need"},
    {"who": "sponsor",    "text": "keep the pilot under 20000 USD",      "tag": "constraint"},
    {"who": "clerk",      "text": "never show other clinics' patients",  "tag": "need"},
]

counts = {"need": 0, "goal": 0, "constraint": 0}
for n in notes:
    counts[n["tag"]] += 1
    print(n["who"], "->", n["tag"])

print("need:", counts["need"])
print("goal:", counts["goal"])
print("constraint:", counts["constraint"])

# مسجّل ملاحظاتك: ضع ملاحظات حقيقية من آخر حديث مع مستخدم، وسّمها، وراقب الأعداد.
notes = [
    {"who": "you", "text": "...", "tag": "need"},       # need | goal | constraint
    {"who": "you", "text": "...", "tag": "goal"},
]

def count_tags(records):
    counts = {}
    for n in records:
        counts[n["tag"]] = counts.get(n["tag"], 0) + 1
    return counts

counts = count_tags(notes)
for tag in sorted(counts):
    print(tag, ":", counts[tag])
print("total notes:", len(notes))
